# Simple Graphs {.unnumbered}

::: {.content-visible when-profile="stata"}
{{< video https://youtu.be/80etyGGtmPw >}}

## Key concepts/commands:

1.  `graph bar`: create a simple bar graph

    ```         
    graph bar, over(sex_text)
    ```

2.  `graph pie`: create a simple pie chart

    ```         
    graph pie, over(sex_text)
    ```

3.  `hist`: create a histogram

    ```         
    hist modrunk
    ```

4.  `kdensity`: create a k-density plot

    ```         
    kdensity modrunk
    ```

5.  `graph box`: create a boxplot

    ```         
    graph box modrunk, hor
    ```

6.  `findit`: find a package to install

    ```         
    findit vioplot
    ```

7.  `vioplot`: create a violin plot (requires installation of user package)

    ```         
    vioplot modrunk, hor
    ```

8.  `stripplot`: create a strip plot (requires installation of user package)

    ```         
    stripplot modrunk, jitter(10) 
    ```
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="r"}
## Model script

``` r
data <- read.csv("https://learndata.net/binge.csv")

# Graphs for qualitative variables (using variable sex_text)

barplot(table(data$sex_text))

pie(table(data$sex_text))

# Graphs for quantitative variables (using variable modrunk)

hist(data$modrunk)

plot(density(data$modrunk))

boxplot(data$modrunk)
boxplot(data$modrunk, horizontal = TRUE)

stripchart(data$modrunk)
stripchart(data$modrunk, method = "jitter")

install.packages("vioplot")
library(vioplot)
vioplot(data$modrunk)
vioplot(data$modrunk, horizontal = TRUE)
```

## Key concepts/syntax:

1.  `barplot(table())`: create a simple bar graph

    ``` r
    barplot(table(data$sex_text))
    ```

2.  `pie(table())`: create a simple pie chart

    ``` r
    pie(table(data$sex_text))
    ```

3.  `hist()`: create a histogram

    ``` r
    hist(data$modrunk)
    ```

4.  `plot(density())`: create a k-density plot

    ``` r
    plot(density(data$modrunk))
    ```

5.  `boxplot()`: create a boxplot

    ``` r
    boxplot(data$modrunk, horizontal = TRUE)
    ```

6.  `stripchart()`: create a strip plot

    ``` r
    stripchart(data$modrunk, method = "jitter")
    ```

7.  `install.packages()`: install a package

    ``` r
    install.packages("vioplot")
    ```

8.  `library()`: load in a package (for this session)

    ``` r
    library(vioplot)
    ```

9.  `vioplot`: create a violin plot, using the `vioplot` package

    ``` r
    vioplot(data$modrunk, horizontal = TRUE)
    ```
:::
